subject: [AMBER] Can not install Amber with CUDA supported

messages.author: Broto Santoso
messages.body:
Dear Amber admin,
I got a problem when installing amber with CUDA support, it said that CUDA
version was not supported. The machine is in the school's lab, so I can not
attach the screenshots or log file in this email yet.
Specs of Machine:
- Centos 7
- NVidia RTX 3080
- NVidia driver version 525.60 (but nvidia-smi shows its Cuda version:
12.0)
- NVCC version 11.8
- Amber22/AmberTools22
Best regards,
--

messages.author: Ross Walker
messages.body:
Hi Broto,
Be sure to apply the latest updates before trying to compile. That will add support for CUDA 11.8. (Note the version reported by nvidia-smi is the latest version of CUDA that the driver will support. nvcc -v gives you the version of the CUDA compiler you are using).
cd amber22_src/
./update_amber --update
All the best
Ross
